extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/context record. Claims are bounded to phenotype and structural-context evidence; no direct molecular mechanism is asserted.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper reports antibiofilm phenotype activity for the synthetic peptides against staphylococcal and Pseudomonas biofilms; this is retained as phenotype-level activity, not a direct mechanism.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Safranin biofilm assay supports biofilm-formation inhibition percentages but does not identify a molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Helical wheel and structural modeling support amphipathic peptide context often associated with membrane-active AMPs, but this paper does not directly assay membrane disruption for these peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Modeling/figure context only; not promoted to direct_mechanism.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Rabbit erythrocyte hemolysis evidence is retained as toxicity/selectivity context for the peptides.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Figure/text provide approximate toxicity context; exact per-peptide database hemolysis rows remain conflict cautions where not text-tabulated.
